surfaces.label: TLS trust and 443 transport (HttpClients, AG-UI stream, upload)
surfaces.notes: WhitelistTrustManager accepts any certificate for whitelisted IPs; hostname verification skipped (candidate-892860315d5c1c76).

surfaces.label: Platform login transport
surfaces.notes: Password POSTed over cleartext HTTP by default; cleartext allowed for 10.0.18.166 (candidate-b994bbefc24e7bae).

surfaces.label: Credential and key storage
surfaces.notes: Password/token/API keys in plaintext SharedPreferences; BuildConfig-injected keys packaged into APK (candidate-2f70cd165037d766).

surfaces.label: Logging and crash retention
surfaces.notes: crash-*.log bypasses xiaoduo-*.log-only rotation/cleanup/export filters; unbounded retention (candidate-c6336a896b504f67).

surfaces.label: Exported components
surfaces.notes: DebugBubbleReceiver exported without permission; FLAG_DEBUGGABLE guard protects release only (candidate-d94011af437600be).

surfaces.label: Device skills and shelf MCP bridge
surfaces.notes: Device commands route through conservative whitelisted intent matchers; the latent runId JSON-template weakness (candidate-a324a24d57ae03c6) was suppressed: runId is client-generated and tools are whitelisted.

surfaces.label: AG-UI client, SSE consumer, file upload
surfaces.notes: Token never logged; SSE parsed defensively; upload bounded to 20MB; error envelopes truncated.

surfaces.label: Cloud ASR/TTS/LLM clients (OpenAI/Aliyun/Volcengine)
surfaces.notes: Keys sent only in headers, never logged; timeouts bounded; malformed responses handled without crashes.

surfaces.label: Chat codecs, session store, view model and screens
surfaces.notes: Corrupt JSON degrades safely; busy/epoch guards prevent cross-session writes; no link/URI handling in message rendering.

surfaces.label: Markdown and bubble rendering
surfaces.notes: Server text rendered as styled plain text only (bold/italic/code spans); no Linkify, WebView, URI launch, or clickable-link surface found repo-wide.

surfaces.label: Voice pipeline (VAD, KWS, ASR/TTS session, wake-ack cache)
surfaces.notes: WAV parsing bounds-checked; buffers bounded (DROP_OLDEST/deques); cache file names sanitized+hashed; no transcript logging.

surfaces.label: General utilities (prefs, logger, app launcher, gestures)
surfaces.notes: No secrets in logs (repo-wide grep); launcher targets user-configured packages; rotation logic clean for its own file class.

surfaces.label: Bundled binary assets (ONNX models, WAV, PNG/WebP)
surfaces.notes: 17 binary assets verified as standard-format data via header/chunk inspection; no executable content; consumed by fixed asset paths.

surfaces.label: Test source set (84 files + fixtures)
surfaces.notes: Unit tests lock down reviewed logic; only dummy credentials in test fixtures; parity WAVs are well-formed test data.
